label: Full supplier predecessor cone of a target
definition: predecessorCone supplies target is the set of all bearers with a finite directed path to target in the supplied relation. The zero-edge path includes target itself. The cone is computed separately for each candidate relation.
note: This applies Mathlib Relation.ReflTransGen to the supplier relation as in SupplierAudit.finiteAuditRootUndecided. The relation is a parameter. An application to actual esse needs the fixed actual-cause profile and a separate evidence interpretation.
